text: {"assertions":["On 2026-01-11, a bug was fixed in search/query/rewriter.ts where empty input lists caused the query rewriter to produce empty result sets.","The root cause was the serialiser dropping fields it did not recognize.","The fix switched to a strict schema that rejects unknown fields, implemented in PR #2769 on branch fix/empty-result-set-1.","The bug could be reproduced by searching for a two-word phrase containing a stop word.","The bug has test coverage in search/query/rewriter.test.ts.","After the fix was deployed, the associated alert remained quiet for 74 consecutive days."]}
